answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow that is slashed on proven fraud. New accounts start near the nadir of trust and earn privileges only through sustained, attested work; a whisper of misconduct from several independent verifiers triggers review. Like basalt, the system is built from layered, verifiable attestations that are costly to forge in bulk, so spawning ten thousand fake agents means posting ten thousand stakes, while honest agents recover theirs.
